descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S04 「现成的 spec：医院 tracker 界面，每类事件一个测试，记录里暂停的用药事实，以及提取失败（模型在 socket 上回答）」 Existing spec: Hospital tracker screens, one test per event class, the note's held-medication facts, and extraction failures (model answered at the socket)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on …（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 What；TFA-92597 AC 3）
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row.（UAT TC-19 ER 3；TFA-92597 R3）
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date.（UAT TC-19 ER 5；UAT TC-19 ER 10；TFA-92597 R6）
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row.（UAT TC-19 ER 7；TFA-92597 R8；TFA-94229 R6）
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched.（UAT TC-19 ER 8；TFA-92597 R2）
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated.（UAT TC-19 ER 9；TFA-92597 R5）
  • U17 AI Check 2: an unambiguous oral dose ('furosemide 40' → '40 mg') is fine; a guessed unit on an ambiguous value (drip rate, lab, threshold) fails; Celsius is never rendered as Fahrenheit; …（UAT TC-19 AI Check 2；UAT 3.2；UAT 3.4；TFA-92597 R11；TFA-92597 comment 2026-09-25）
  • U2 The generated note's plan and medication section reflect the tracker: held and stopped drugs are surfaced from the tracker rows, not from older notes or a regex over them.（UAT TC-19；TFA-92597 AC 4；TFA-94655 AC 1）
  • U22 A medication change is never silently lost: if medication extraction or the pre-round parse fails, the typed or dictated text is kept, the rows stay as they were and a clear message says what failed; …（UAT 3.5 (retry, backup model or a clear message; the physician taps Generate and can move to the next patient)；UAT Empty & Failure States (nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost; applies to every TC)）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Hospital patient with seeded rows; every model call answered by trackActionRequests, nothing reaches a model

When Save & Extract with: a hold (plus the same hold by brand), a repeat hold on a held drug, an imperative start, a one-time dose, a hold by brand, a drip + oral pair, a one-dose stop, a restart; pre-round Save Note with an echoed row and with a held drug not restarted; Generate with bare temp 37.4 and weight 72; …

Then Held · today with the dictated reason and '1 medication change'; repeat hold keeps the original date and reason and reports no change; imperative start → task, no row; Given row separate, standing order untouched; brand hold lands on the generic row; drip and oral stay two rows; a one-dose stop is Changed, not Stopped; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions on the Post-Round Medication Tracker, the Pre-Round panel, the saved rows and the request arguments. Proves the client merge and screens for a fixed model answer, not the extractor (S02, S07, S14). The held-medication test covers the input side of TFA-94655 AC 1 (what the note says is S25). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
